description:
NGAPHAMBI KOKUTHENGA — OKUNCIKE KUKHO I-DAWNLIST

I-Dawnlist isebenzisa i-generative AI ukufunda izikhangiso zemisebenzi, ukuzahlulela ngokumelene nesifinyezo sakho, futhi iqambe imilayezo yakho. Isebenza ngokusebenzisa ukhiye wakho we-Anthropic API. Uzodinga owodwa, futhi i-Anthropic ikukhokhisa ngokuqondile ngalokho i-Dawnlist ekufundayo — ngokuvamile amaphawundi ambalwa ngenyanga ekusetshenzisweni okujwayelekile. Ukudala ukhiye kuthatha imizuzu embalwa ku-console.anthropic.com. I-Dawnlist ayithathi ingxenye futhi ayifaki inzuzo eyengeziwe. Uma ungathandi ukubamba ukhiye we-API, lolu hlelo alukhona kuwe.

I-Dawnlist iwuhlelo lokubhalisa, oluthengwa ohlelweni ngokusebenzisa i-Microsoft Store. Ngenkathi isebenza, ifunda imisebenzi yezinsuku zonke ngenxa yakho, futhi lokho kufunda kubiza imali nsuku zonke — ngakho-ke ibekwa intengo ngendlela ebiza ngayo. Ukubhalisa okukodwa kuvula uhlelo lonke: ayikho izinga lesibili, akukho okugcinwe ngemuva, futhi akukho ukwenza kuhle okuzothengwa kamuva.

I-Dawnlist ifunda imisebenzi yomhlaba wonke njalo ekuseni, yahlulele isikhangiso ngasinye ngokumelene nesifinyezo sokufaneleka esikwakha kanye nawe, futhi ikunikeze uhlu olubalulekile oluhlelwe ngokwezinga ngaphambi kokuba uqede ikhofi yakho.

Ayisoze ithumele lutho. Yonke imilayezo eyibhalayo iwuhlaka oluvulwa futhi oluthunyelwe uwena kusuka kuhlelo lwakho lwe-imeyili. Lokho ngumkhawulo ohlelwe ngamabomu, hhayi umkhawulo wamandla: uhlala ungumuntu onquma ukuthi yini ephuma egameni lakho.


OKWENZAYO

Uhlu olubalulekile njalo ekuseni
I-Dawnlist ihlanza imisebenzi yezinsuku, isuse lokho osekukubonile noma osekukwenqabile, bese ifunda okusele. Uthola uhlu olubalulekile oluhlelwe ngezinga elinezizathu — futhi, ngokungajwayelekile, ukwenqatshwa nakho kuyabonakala, ngakunye nesizathu esenza kwabekwa eceleni. Akukho okunyamalala ngokuthula.

Ikhombisa ukusebenza kwayo
Ukusebenza ngakunye kukhombisa yonke inqubo: ukuthi zingaki izikhangiso ezahlanzwa, zasuswa ukuphindaphindeka, zahlungwa, zahlolwa futhi zahlaziywa. Isibalo asikaze sikhonjiswe ngaphandle kwalokho esikuvimbayo, ngakho-ke ungabona njalo ukuthi uhlu olubalulekile lwezine lwaphuma kanjani ekuhlanzweni kwenkulungwane.

Ifunda ukwahlulela kwakho, hhayi amagama abalulekile kuphela
Ngaphambi kokusebenza kokuqala, i-Dawnlist ikukhombisa izikhangiso eziyishumi eziphilayo kanye nesinqumo sayo kusinye ngasinye. Lapho ungavumelani, uyitshele ukuthi yiluphi usentensi obeluzoyithola ilungile, futhi lolo sentensi lungena esifinyezweni sakho. Konke ukulungiswa emva kwalokho kwenza okufanayo. Le yingxenye eyenza kube okwakho kunokuba kube okujwayelekile.

Isilandeleli esibonisa iqiniso
Yonke inkampani oyilandelela, ngesigaba sayo, irekhodi lobufakazi balokho okwathunyelwa ngempela, nokuthi yini elandelayo edingekayo. Izinsuku zokulandelela zibalwa ngokususela kubuxhumano osubuqophile ngempela — akusoze kwaba kusuka enkambeni engasasebenzi — futhi azisoze zawela ngoMsombuluko noma ngoLwesihlanu.

Amahlaka ngezwi lakho, ngolimi lwakho
I-Dawnlist ibhala okulandelayo ngendlela yokukhuluma oyisebenzisa ngempela, efundwe kusukela kwimilayezo yakho ethunyelwe owengeza wena ngokwakho. Isebenza ngezilimi ezingamashumi amahlanu. Futhi konke okushiwo okuyiqiniso kuvela emniningwaneni wangemuva owakhiwe ngama-CV akho; lapho ubufakazi bungayisekeli isimangalo, kushiya isikhala esibonakalayo esikhundleni sokuqamba okuthile.


OKUNGAKWENZI

Ayithumeli. Awukho ikhodi yokuthumela ohlelweni nhlobo.
Ayifundi ibhokisi lakho leposi. Azikho amaphasiwedi, akukho ukufinyelela kwibhokisi lokungena, akukho okumele kuxhunywe.
Ayifaki isicelo egameni lakho, noma igcwalise amafomu, noma ithumele umlayezo kunoma ubani ngenxa yakho.
Ayihlwanyeli amabhodi emisebenzi.

Uma ufuna uhlelo oluthumela izicelo ezilikhulu ngenkathi ulele, lolu akulona. I-Dawnlist ingeyabantu abafuna izindlela ezimbalwa, ezahlulelwa kangcono, futhi abahlose ukusekela ngasinye sazo.


INDLELA IDATHA YAKHO EPHATHWA NGAYO

Ama-CV akho, isifinyezo sakho kanye nesilandeleli sakho kuhlala emshinini wakho.

Izincazelo zomsebenzi kanye nesifinyezo sakho sokufaneleka kuthunyelwa ku-API ye-Anthropic ukuze kuhlaziywe, ngaphansi KOKHIYE WAKHO WE-API — ngakho-ke leyo trafiki iphakathi kwakho ne-Anthropic, futhi i-Dawnlist ayiyona ingxenye yayo. Ukusesha kwemisebenzi kudlula esevisini yokudla ye-Dawnlist, eqopha izibalo zokusetshenziswa futhi ayisoze yaqopha okuqukethwe.

Imininingwane egcwele isenqubomgomweni yobumfihlo.


UKUBIKA LOKHO I-DAWNLIST EKUBHALAYO

Ngenxa yokuthi izinqumo namahlaka e-Dawnlist akhiqizwa yi-AI, kunendlela yokusitshela lapho ikhiqiza okuthile okungafanele, okucasulayo noma okungalungile ngokusobala. Vula Izilungiselelo bese usebenzisa "Bika okuqukethwe okukhiqizwe yi-AI", noma ubhalele ku-Apps@spencerfields.com. Umbiko ubhalwa ngumuntu, awuthunyelwa uhlelo — ukuchaza okwenzekile kwanele.


UKUQALA

Ukulungiselela kuthatha cishe isigamu sehora: engeza ama-CV akho, tshela i-Dawnlist ngawe kanye nalokho okufunayo, bese uyilungisa kwizikhangiso eziyishumi zangempela. Ngemuva kwalokho isebenza njalo ekuseni.


OKUKHOKHELA KHONA

Ukubhalisa okukodwa, kanye nohlelo lonke. Akukho okuvalelwe ngemuva kwenkokhelo yesibili futhi akukho sici esigcinwe ngemuva.

Ukudla kwemisebenzi kufakiwe. Ukusesha kubiza imali yangempela nsuku zonke i-Dawnlist isebenza, futhi yilokho ukubhalisa okukukhokhelayo.

Ukufunda nokwakha amahlaka kwehlukene, futhi ukhokha i-Anthropic ngokuqondile ngokhiye wakho we-API. Ekusetshenzisweni okujwayelekile lokho kuvamise ukuba ipondo elilodwa noma amabili ngenyanga. Ubamba ukhiye, ubona ukusetshenziswa, futhi ungawuhoxisa noma nini. I-Dawnlist ayisoze yabona leyo bhili futhi ayithathi sabelo kuyo.

Kungani ukhiye wakho hhayi owethu: ama-CV akho, isifinyezo sakho sokufaneleka kanye nezincazelo zemisebenzi i-Dawnlist ezifundayo kungumlando wakho wokuqashwa. Ukuzithumela ngengqalasizinda yethu kuzosenza sibe umgcini werekhodi lakho lomsebenzi. Ukhiye wakho kusho ukuthi leyo trafiki iphakathi kwakho ne-Anthropic, futhi asiyona ingxenye yayo.

release_notes:
Yakha imibuzo yosesho lwe-boolean ngesikhiqizi semibuzo se-LinkedIn — hlanganisa amagama abalulekile, izihloko kanye nokukhishwa kube inkulumo eyodwa bese uyinamathisela ngqo ku-LinkedIn.

Ngenisa isikhangiso somsebenzi kusuka ku-URL yaso ye-LinkedIn. Namathisela isixhumanisi futhi i-Dawnlist iyisengeze esilandelelini sakho ngesihloko, inkampani nencazelo kugcwalisiwe.

Imithombo eminingi yemisebenzi ngemuva kwezigcawu. I-Dawnlist manje idonsa kokuningi kokudla futhi igcina inguqulo ecebile lapho isikhangiso esifanayo sivela kabili.

Ngenisa futhi ukhiphe usesho lwakho njengespredishithi, ukuze ukwazi ukwakha isethi kufayela le-CSV bese uyifaka konke kanyekanye kunokuthayipha ngakunye.

Khipha izisombululo zakho zokufaneleka njengedokhumenti elakhiwe kahle, ulilungise ngaphandle kohlelo bese uliphinda ungenise — kuwusizo lapho omunye umuntu ekusiza ukubumba lokho okufunayo.

Hlola uxhumano lwakho kusuka Ezilungiselelweni ngaphandle kokulinda ukusebenza kwasekuseni. Inkinobho eyodwa ihlola ukhiye wakho we-API nokufinyelela kokudla futhi ikutshele ngokushesha ukuthi konke kuyasebenza yini.

Ukusesha manje kungahambisana nesihloko somsebenzi, incazelo noma kokubili, futhi ungengeza amagama abalulekile encazelo ukunciphisa okubuyayo.
